title: Beige Account Referral Program
summary: This document explains the Beige Account Enterprise Referral Program: $500 premium referral bonus for the referrer, a $350 welcome bonus for the referred enterprise, capped at 15 referral bonuses per calendar year. To qualify, the referrer must have 120+ days since opening their first checking account; the enterprise must open a Beige Account and deposit at least $100,000 within 120 days. Bonuses are credited only after all requirements are confirmed via the referrer’s relationship manager.
